title: Keep Night allocation badges visible
summary: Team allocation rows now keep long professional names and live status badges readable without clipped pills on phone screens.
changes: Fixes Team allocation rows so live status chips such as Next, Now and Complete reserve their own space instead of being cropped beside long professional names.
Lets paired professional names wrap naturally while keeping the You badge, live state and row chevron readable across small phone widths.
Adds browser regression coverage for the long-name Second Part allocation layout without changing roster, break or clock-change logic.
